snippet.title: Bob Saves The Princess - Trailer
snippet.description:
===================== WISHLIST NOW =====================

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752560/Bob_Saves_The_Princess/

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Bob Saves The Princess is a new roguelite coming soon for Steam.
Bob heard the Princess had gone missing and went to look for her, meanwhile the Princess snuck into the depths of the Tempus dungeon and stole a time controlling artifact. 
You play as the Princess trying to get Bob to the last floor of the dungeon safe as you control items, rooms and much more that is available through the central control table.

A game by Milton_Filto
Song by Gabriel Nunes
